capabilities: Create song notes with metadata fields for title, key, tempo, time signature, genre, themes, and influences
Structure song notes into Lyrics, Chords, Notes, and Recording Ideas sections
Capture lyric ideas as snippet notes in a dedicated Snippets folder
Launch a helper that reminds you to check a rhyme dictionary
List songs in a sidebar grouped by status with title, key, and status badge
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The rhyme helper only reminds you to use an external rhyme dictionary; it does not include one.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in structure for writing songs, so lyricists must set up their own note formats and track songs manually.
summary: Songwriting notebook that creates structured song notes (lyrics, chords, key, tempo) plus a snippets folder and a songs sidebar grouped by status.
